backend/main.mo: Actor implementing access control, user profiles, blob storage mixin, and rate card CRUD with ordered map storage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping PDF‑export fixes to affected frontend files and related components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing responsibilities of multiple frontend components, utilities, and config files.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading SheetJS and jsPDF libraries via CDN and bootstrapping the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring query client, theme, header/footer, and rendering MainApp.
frontend/src/components/AccountManagerMa: UI for uploading, adding, listing, and deleting account managers with CSV import and backend mutations.
frontend/src/components/AnalysisTab.tsx: Quote analysis UI enabling cost editing, margin calculations, and Excel/PDF export operations.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Empty or missing content; no implementation provided.
frontend/src/components/MainApp.tsx: Defines the main tabbed application layout and manages navigation and state for quotes, analysis, history, reports, rate card, and settings.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Empty placeholder file with no implementation.
frontend/src/components/QuoteGenerator.t: Implements a full quote creation workflow with item selection, filtering, header fields, live totals, and triggers for generating quotes and analysis.
Displays previously generated quotes in a table and allows reloading a selected quote into the app.
frontend/src/components/QuoteSummary.tsx: Shows a generated quote summary and provides export options for Excel, PDF, and printing.
Handles uploading, parsing, previewing, and updating rate card data from CSV or Excel files.
Presents a preview of parsed rate card items and allows confirming or canceling a full rate card replacement.
frontend/src/components/RateCardTable.ts: Renders a scrollable table displaying rate card items with key details and costs.
frontend/src/components/ReportsTab.tsx: Displays quote history, allows selecting a quote, and exports selected quote details to Excel.
frontend/src/components/SettingsTab.tsx: Renders the settings page container including the account manager management UI.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor instance based on Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context with login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps backend actor calls with React Query hooks for rate cards, quotes, analysis, and account manager CRUD operations.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS base styles, theme variables, dark mode overrides, and print-specific styling.
frontend/src/lib/accountManagerParser.ts: Parses CSV or Excel files to extract account manager records, validating headers and formatting output.
frontend/src/lib/excelParser.ts: Parses XLSX files in the browser using SheetJS, validating required headers and converting rows into structured item data.
frontend/src/lib/formatters.ts: Provides helper functions for formatting numbers, currency, and percentages.
frontend/src/lib/pdfExporter.ts: Generates quote and analysis PDFs using jsPDF and autoTable, with helpers for formatting and layout.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point initializing React, React Query, and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration extending colors, themes, animations, and enabling plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing architecture notes, issues, and feature requests related to PDF export and rate card upload.
